title: A screen-flow result screen (only `record_link` fields) still shows Cancel, and closing it neither completes the run nor refreshes the record — the converted lead still reads Qualified
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found while landing objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2297 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2339, report comment 6450816541 on hotcrm#2297), the first use of the 18.2.0 `record_link` screen field (#25872). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`). Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium (screenshot `06-after-cancel-page-not-refreshed.png` in the HotCRM project files `issue-2297/`).

## What is seen

HotCRM's `lead_conversion` now ends on a screen whose every field is a read-only `record_link` (the created account, contact, opportunity). The dialog still draws **Cancel** and **Submit**. **Cancel** (or the close button) closes it without completing the run, so the record page is not refreshed: the lead that was just converted still shows *Qualified* until a reload, and "Cancel" reads as if it could undo a conversion already written.

**Who loses:** every flow that ends on a result screen — the rep sees a stale record and a misleading button.

## Expected

A screen with no input fields offers one **Done** (or closing it completes the run), and the completion refreshes the record page as Submit does.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "screen flow result screen record_link Cancel does not complete run page not refreshed": 5 hits — #25872 (closed, the fix that added `record_link`, which this follows up), #26657, #9468, #4477, #3528 (closed). None reports Cancel on a result screen.

**Reader who acts:** the console screen-flow dialog owner (seam `SCREEN_FIELD_RECORD_LINK_TYPE` → the app-shell flow dialog).
